description: Call an HTTP API of a registered project through Lantern, e.g. tool="browser", method="POST", path="/tasks/execute", body={...}. Lantern finds the running server's address; you give the project and a path. Returns the response body (cut at `max_bytes`, default 100000). Only registered projects are reachable. Endpoints marked risk high/critical, or projects needing confirmation, are not sent until `confirm=true`: ask the user first. For calls over ~50s set `async=true` to get a `job_id`, then use `get_operation` or `get_job_result`. See `get_project_endpoints` for what exists.

confirm.description: True only after user approval for a risky call.

method.description: GET, POST, PUT, PATCH or DELETE; default GET.

path.description: Absolute path on the registered server, optionally with query.

name: call_tool_api

description: Health of Lantern itself (dns, caddy, tls, daemon) and of every instance (healthy, unhealthy, unreachable, unknown; latency; last check). With `name` returns only that instance. `refresh=true` runs a check now instead of using the cached result.

name.description: Project name or id; omit for all.

name: check_health

description: Dependency graph between projects (`depends_on` in manifests): what each needs and what depends on it. Pass `name` for one project. Check it before stopping or restarting something others rely on.
name: get_dependencies

description: Fetch the result of an async `call_tool_api` job by `job_id`. While running: status and elapsed time. When done: the response body. On failure: the error. Jobs are kept for 1 hour after they finish. (`get_operation` returns the same job as an operation.)
name: get_job_result

description: Check a long operation started by `start_project`, `start_branch`, `restart_project` or `call_tool_api` with `async=true`. Returns status (running, succeeded, failed, cancelled), the current step, and the error if it failed. `wait_seconds` (max 55) blocks until it finishes or the time passes, so you do not need to poll in a loop.

operation_id.description: Operation id returned by a long-running tool.

name: get_operation

description: Which ports are in use: Lantern's assignment per instance (with status, health, URL), processes Lantern did not start that listen on localhost (pid, command, working directory, the project they appear to belong to), and port conflicts. Never guess a port; use this.
name: get_ports

description: Full details of one project: path, URLs, status, run command, health endpoint, dependencies, risk/confirmation metadata, docs and endpoint counts, and all its instances (branches). Pass `branch` or `instance` for that specific checkout instead of the primary.

branch.description: Branch of an existing instance; omit for primary.

instance.description: Existing instance id; takes precedence over branch.

name.description: Project name or id; an instance id also works.

name: get_project

description: Show how Lantern found a project's docs and endpoints: the auto-discovery settings (docs_auto, api_auto), discovered versus manual entries, sources tried, errors, last refresh time. Use to debug missing docs or endpoints.

branch.description: Branch of an existing instance; omit for primary.

instance.description: Existing instance id; takes precedence over branch.

name.description: Project name or id; an instance id also works.

name: get_project_discovery

description: List or read a project's documentation files (README, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, docs/**/*.md, plus anything its manifest lists). Without `path`: the list with kind and size. With `path`: the file text, paged by `offset`/`max_chars`. Reads the targeted branch's checkout, so the docs match that branch. Only listed files can be read.

branch.description: Branch of an existing instance; omit for primary.

instance.description: Existing instance id; takes precedence over branch.

name.description: Project name or id; an instance id also works.

path.description: Listed document path; omit to list.

name: get_project_docs

description: List the HTTP API endpoints of a project (from its manifest and its OpenAPI/Swagger document): method, path, description, category, risk, body hint. Use before `call_tool_api`. `q` filters by substring of path, description or category; `limit` caps the list (default 200).

branch.description: Branch of an existing instance; omit for primary.

instance.description: Existing instance id; takes precedence over branch.

name.description: Project name or id; an instance id also works.

q.description: Filter by path, description, or category.

name: get_project_endpoints

description: Recent log output (stdout and stderr, newest last) of a project's dev server. First stop when something fails to start or returns errors. `tail` lines (default 200, max 2000), `since` ("15m", "2h" or an ISO time), `stream` (stdout, stderr or all), `grep` (case-insensitive substring filter). Targets the primary unless `branch`/`instance` is given.

branch.description: Branch of an existing instance; omit for primary.

instance.description: Existing instance id; takes precedence over branch.

name.description: Project name or id; an instance id also works.

name: get_project_logs

description: List instances (one per git checkout) with branch, status, port, URL, health, dirty flag and checkout path. Filter by `project`, `status` or `branch`. Use to see which branches are running side by side, or to find the instance id for other tools.
name: list_instances

description: Raw list of TCP sockets listening on localhost with owning process, command line, working directory, and the matched project/instance. Finds servers started by hand in a terminal. Filters: `project`, `port`, `unmatched_only`.

unmatched_only.description: Only listeners with no matching instance.

name: list_listeners

description: List projects registered in Lantern (local dev servers, tools, websites) with status, URL and port. Start here to see what exists and what is running. Shows the primary checkout's status and how many branch instances exist; use `list_instances` for per-branch detail, `get_project` for full config. Filters: `tag`; `kind` (project, service, tool, capability, website); `status` (running, stopped, starting, stopping, crashed, unhealthy, needs_config, external; `error` also accepted).
name: list_projects

description: List the tools agents can call through Lantern: projects of kind `tool` or `capability` (browser automation, data services, ...). Shows description, status, domain, risk, whether calls need confirmation, trigger keywords and endpoints. Then use `get_project_docs`, `get_project_endpoints` and `call_tool_api`. Filters: `tag`, `status`, `kind`.
name: list_tools

description: Re-scan docs and re-fetch OpenAPI documents now (normally refreshed every 10 minutes and when a server starts). Pass a project/instance, or nothing to refresh all. Takes up to 30 seconds.

name.description: Project name or id; omit for all.

name: refresh_discovery

description: Restart a project's dev server (stop, then start). Acts on the primary unless `branch`/`instance` is given. Waits up to `wait_seconds` (default 40, max 55), then returns an `operation_id`.

branch.description: Branch of an existing instance; omit for primary.

instance.description: Existing instance id; takes precedence over branch.

name.description: Project name or id; an instance id also works.

name: restart_project

description: Find projects by free text (case-insensitive substring of name, description, tags, or git branch names). Use when you remember only part of a name or want projects related to a topic such as "browser" or "postgres".

query.description: Search name, description, tags or branch.

name: search_projects

description: Run a git branch of a project side by side with the others: creates a git worktree for `branch` if there is none (new branches start from `base`, default the primary's current branch), runs setup (copies .env, installs dependencies), starts it, and returns its own URL such as https://feature-x.myapp.glow. Safe to repeat; an existing instance is reused. Can take minutes: after `wait_seconds` (default 45, max 55) you get an `operation_id` and the work continues; poll `get_operation`. `start=false` only prepares the worktree.

start.description: Start the server; defaults to true.

name: start_branch

description: Start a project's dev server. Safe to repeat: if it is already running, reports its URL. Acts on the primary checkout unless `branch` (an existing instance) or `instance` is given; to run a branch with no instance yet use `start_branch`. Waits up to `wait_seconds` (default 30, max 55) for the server to accept connections; if still starting it returns an `operation_id` for `get_operation`.

branch.description: Branch of an existing instance; omit for primary.

instance.description: Existing instance id; takes precedence over branch.

name.description: Project name or id; an instance id also works.

name: start_project

description: Stop a project's dev server (its whole process group). Safe to repeat. Acts on the primary unless `branch`/`instance` is given. Deletes nothing. Check `get_dependencies` first if other projects rely on it.

branch.description: Branch of an existing instance; omit for primary.

instance.description: Existing instance id; takes precedence over branch.

name.description: Project name or id; an instance id also works.

name: stop_project
